title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend
overview: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

title: Godzilla Minus Zero
overview: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.

title: SAYANG
overview: Nancy, an Indian-descended mother, returns to her hometown and opens a sign language school while caring for her son Ajay, who lives with both hearing impairment and a neurological condition. Among her students are Mina, a Malay girl determined to become a Muay Thai boxer despite cultural expectations, and Sansan, a Chinese girl deeply bound to the ocean she loves. Along the vast coastline, three families and three children navigate faith, identity, and freedom, until their intertwined lives become a moving symphony of resilience and love.

title: BAGA: Tomorrow Belongs to No One
overview: In a conservative East Coast village, two young lovers struggle to escape poverty and tradition when an unexpected pregnancy pushes them into difficult choices, leading one to turn to drug trafficking in a desperate bid for a better future.

title: Kacau
overview: After a game of Spirit of the Coin goes horribly wrong, a group of friends begin dying in gruesome ways, forcing the survivors to fight for their lives while uncovering a dark secret among them.

title: The Age Of Goodbyes
overview: Set in Malaysia, the film follows a young woman named Du Li An who falls in love with a man named Lin Sang in 1969 before he mysteriously disappears. Years later, after marrying a gangster and becoming stepmother to a teenage girl, Du Li An encounters a man who looks exactly like her vanished lover. The decade-spanning narrative blends elements of romance, mystery and coming-of-age storytelling.

title: The Doll Ghawiah
overview: It all began with an accident on Babakan Siliwangi Road. Nala encountered a mysterious little girl and her doll in the Babakan Siliwangi forest. The doll’s name was Ghawiah, which means “lost.” Ever since that accident, many strange occurrences have begun to haunt the local residents.

title: How to Rob a Bank
overview: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

title: Baby Udon
overview: Fanny Kondoh, a young Indonesian woman, falls in love with Hajime Kondoh, a Japanese man who comes to Indonesia for work.  After getting married, Fanny and Hajime begin building a life together, embracing both its joys and challenges. As they struggle to fulfill their dream of having a child, they are faced with one heartbreaking trial after another, testing the strength of their love, especially when Hajime is diagnosed with cancer.

title: Never Dies
overview: Amidst imminent financial ruin, a debt-ridden man experiences profound relief upon discovering his estranged late father’s substantial life insurance policy—only to be thrown into an absurd moral crisis when the patriarch unexpectedly resuscitates inside the hearse en route to the funeral home.

title: Bisikan
overview: A young man haunted by past trauma and hated by his father begins to experience disturbing whispers and horrifying visions in an old mansion. As he struggles to save his family, he becomes trapped between reality and his own imagination.

title: Takluk 2: OP Daulat
overview: An operation that shook the nation starting on February 11, 2013. At that time, Sulu terrorists infiltrated Kampung Tanduo in Lahad Datu, Sabah. By the end of "Op Daulat", 56 terrorists and six civilians were reported killed. The conflict also saw 12 national heroes fall in battle after sacrificing their lives to defend the nation's sovereignty.

title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
overview: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

title: Inherit
overview: Follows a wealthy family whose polished exterior begins to crack when an ancient centipede spirit infiltrates their bloodline.
